texts: Severe CTEPH with surgically accessible disease, here complete occlusion of both lower lobe arteries and webs in the upper lobe branches, should go to surgery: pulmonary endarterectomy: D.
Suprasystemic pressures and a pulmonary vascular resistance above 1000 dyn.s/cm5 raise the risk of the operation but do not rule it out, because the obstruction that causes them can be removed.

Anticoagulation, diuretics and pulmonary vasodilators cannot dissolve organised fibrous clot, the stones that do not fear the bottles, and waiting six months only lets the right ventricle fail further.
Declining treatment would leave a patient whose outlook without surgery is very poor.
Memory hook: the stones do not fear bottles; the scraper takes them out.
